subject.title: Add loop-aware compaction guard for saturated sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a new saturated-session compaction guard beyond the shipped safeguard summary checks and post-compaction identical-tool abort, and what config/default/reset policy should it use?
rationale: The remaining work is not a mechanical bug fix because it creates public config/default surface and decides when OpenClaw should strengthen compaction, validate summaries, or recommend reset after a degraded session.

options.title: Keep As Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the config namespace, default behavior, validator contract, and reset-recommendation policy before accepting or replacing the config-scaffold PR.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Guard Follow-Ups
options.body: Split the umbrella into smaller issues around summary quality, post-compaction loop detection, and the separate compaction-rate-limit tracker, then close this broad design item after those are linked.

options.title: Reject New Guard Surface
options.body: Decline the new guard/config direction and rely on safeguard compaction, the shipped post-compaction loop guard, and narrower rate-limit work.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the config namespace, default behavior, validator contract, and reset-recommendation policy before accepting or replacing the config-scaffold PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source and history route the compaction/runtime policy decision most clearly through steipete's recent work on these files.
